subject: Colossus statue's outstretched hand
text: Opening the chest that appears on the Colossus statue's outstretched hand yields the Mirror Shield.

evidence.quote: As you come out onto the Colossus statue's outstretched hand, a chest will appear.  Open it to get the Mirror Shield.

subject: Mirror Shield
text: The Mirror Shield can reflect light, absorb certain kinds of magic, and cannot be stolen by Like-Likes.

evidence.quote: Two, it can reflect light.  Three, it can absorb certain kinds of magic (this actually only works in one boss fight, but it's worth mentioning).  Lastly, it can't be stolen by Like-Likes.

subject: East Iron Knuckle Room
text: Running through the door in front and then through the northeast door leads to the Upper East Stairwell.

evidence.quote: Run through the door in front of you, then through the door in the northeast corner of the room.

subject: Upper East Stairwell
text: Running down the stairs in the Upper East Stairwell and through the north door leads to the Quad Armos Room.

evidence.quote: Run down the stairs and through the door on the north side of the room.

subject: Quad Armos Room north door
text: Standing in the beam of light and aiming the Mirror Shield at the wall's sun panel unseals the north door.

evidence.quote: Stand in the beam of light, and aim the Mirror Shield (hold R) at the sun panel on the wall.  The door in the north of the room will unseal itself.

subject: Small Key Room
text: Opening the chest inside the Small Key Room yields a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Run into the room and open the chest to get a Small Key.

subject: Quad Armos Room
text: The door on the west side of the Quad Armos Room leads into the Treble Anubis Room.

evidence.quote: Go through the door on the west side of the room, to your right as you come out of the Small Key Room.

subject: Treble Anubis Room
text: Unlocking and passing through the locked door in the southwest corner of the Treble Anubis Room leads to the Sliding Panels Room.

evidence.quote: Head to the southwest corner of the room and go through the locked door.

subject: Sliding Panels Room
text: Beamos on pillars can be killed with thrown bombs, and the wall of sliding panels can be scaled by climbing aligned platforms or using the Longshot.

evidence.quote: As you come into the room, kill the pair of Beamos on the pillars by throwing bombs at them.  Look at the wall to the right after you do.  It's covered with sliding panels, each of which contains a platform that can be climbed on.  Now, you can either wait for the panels to align and climb up... or you can just aim for the top panel and use the Longshot.

subject: Sliding Panels Room
text: Destroying both Beamos enemies atop the panel ladder lets you proceed through the north door.

evidence.quote: At the top of the ladder of panels, destroy both of the Beamos enemies and go through the north door.

subject: Triforce Door Room door
text: Standing on the Triforce symbol atop the stairs and playing Zelda's Lullaby unseals the door in front of it.

evidence.quote: Go up the stairs, and stand on the Triforce symbol at the top.  Stand on it and play Zelda's Lullaby, and the door before the triforce symbol will unseal itself.

subject: Boss Key Room
text: Shooting the golden eye behind the false door reveals a high platform, allowing you to Longshot up, step on a switch, and open the ornate chest holding the Boss Key.

evidence.quote: The false door to the left of the pillar of flames hides a golden eye.  Shoot the eye with an arrow, and a second platform will appear high above the room.  Aim for the Longshot target above this platform, and then jump from that platform to the one above the pillar of flames.  Step on the switch, and the pillar will disappear, letting you access the ornate chest that holds the Boss Key.

subject: Triforce Door Room
text: Heading through the door on the west side of the Triforce Door Room leads into the Upper Sun Chamber.

evidence.quote: Go right as you come out of the Boss Key Room, through the door on the west side of the area.

subject: Upper Sun Chamber crystal switch
text: Activating the crystal switch behind the bars with a vertical sword slash or spin attack opens the sealed door.

evidence.quote: activate the crystal switch behind the bars to the left with a vertical sword slash or a spin attack.  The sealed door in front of you will open.

subject: Upper Sun Chamber mirror puzzle
text: Bombing the odd rock formation opens a passage, allowing mirrors to be rotated east and north to channel sunlight into the ceiling mirror and activate the elevator sun panel.

evidence.quote: Go to the east side of the room, and drop a bomb on the odd formation of rock there to blast open an opening to the next room.  Staying in the current room, move around to the back of the mirror, grab hold of the left handle, and push it until the mirror faces east, through the doorway you just opened...Grab hold of the left handle, and push it until the mirror faces north...Back in the first area of this odd room, notice that the beam of sunlight from the two mirrors in the other half of the room are shining on the large mirror on the ceiling.  Jump down into the pit, and stand in this beam of sunlight.  Use it to activate the sun panel on the west wall using the Mirror Shield, and the floor will begin to lower - it's really an elevator.

subject: The Colossus Room
text: Reflecting the sunlight beam onto the Colossus statue's face disintegrates it into a grating, which can be Longshotted to reveal the Boss Door.

evidence.quote: Use the Mirror Shield to reflect the beam onto the statue's face, where it will begin to disintegrate, revealing a grating.  Target the grating with the Longshot, and pull yourself over to it.  When you land, the grating will rise, revealing the Boss Door.  Go through it.

subject: Iron Knuckle
text: Using the Biggoron Sword, Nayru's Love, and the Backflip Jump Attack trick is effective against the Iron Knuckle mini-boss in Nabooru's Throne Room.

evidence.quote: Remember to use the Biggoron Sword if you have it (which you can, should, by now), since the shield is basically worthless against the Iron Knuckle's attacks.  Again, if the battle gets too hot, then use Nayru's Love.  The Backflip/Jump Attack trick works really well on this Iron Knuckle as well.

subject: Iron Knuckle
text: Defeating the Iron Knuckle breaks its armor to reveal Nabooru, whom Koume and Kotake then capture with a spell before teleporting away.

evidence.quote: After a relatively quick battle, the Knuckle's armor will fall off, revealing Nabooru.  Koume and Kotake had brainwashed her, which was how she ended up as Ganondorf's loyal servant.  The twins will appear again and capture Nabooru use some kind of spell on Nabooru, whereupon she disappears, then teleport away themselves.

subject: Twinrova
text: In phase one of the boss fight, the Mirror Shield must be used without Z-Targeting to reflect one sister's elemental beam into the opposing sister.

evidence.quote: The Sisters each have their own element which opposes the other.  Kotake is Ice, and Koume is Fire...You have to now use the Mirror Shield to reflect this beam into the other sister, much as you reflected the beams of light earlier in the dungeon...Don't even TRY to Z-Target to aim the beam; if you do, the beam will just fire off in some random direction and won't even get near the other sister.

subject: Twinrova
text: In phase two, the Mirror Shield must absorb three consecutive spells of the same alignment to unleash a massive beam that stuns Twinrova.

evidence.quote: In order to stun Twinrova and make her vulnerable to attack, you have to absorb three spells of the same alignment IN A ROW.  This means that, if you absorb two fire spells, then an ice spell, then the two fires will be negated and you have to absorb two more ice spells.

After you absorb three beams of the same alignment in a row, then the Mirror Shield will unleash a massive beam back at Twinrova (keep the shield drawn to make sure the beam connects).  This will stun her momentarily, causing her to fall to the platform below her.

subject: Twinrova
text: Once Twinrova is stunned on the lower platform, equipping Hover Boots and landing a Jump Attack followed by sword strikes damages her.

evidence.quote: At this point, quickly equip the Hover Boots and draw your sword.  Run out to Twinrova.  When you're halfway across the gap, use a Jump Attack to go the rest of the way and damage Twinrova at the same time.  Then switch to basic sword strikes.

subject: Twinrova chamber
text: Defeating Twinrova leaves a Heart Container on one of the outer platforms in the chamber.

evidence.quote: Take the Heart Container that they leave behind, which is on one of the outer platforms in the chamber.  This should also be your twentieth Heart Container - congratulations.

subject: Nabooru
text: Entering the beam of light opposite the Heart Container awakens Nabooru as the Sage of Spirit and grants the Spirit Medallion.

evidence.quote: Enter the beam of light opposite the Heart Container to meet the Sage of Spirit: Nabooru...Once all six of the sages are assembled (Rauru, Saria, Darunia, Ruto, Impa and Nabooru), then a cutscene will take place immediately after you get the final medallion.  Rauru will tell you to return to the Temple of Time.
